summary: Computes a packed color-like 32-bit integer from a time-driven triangular wave. Adds the session-time global (dbl_8AFEA0) to a float argument, runs a side-effect call (InterruptDispatch) on the sum, folds the value into [0,1] with a triangle wave (around 0.5), clamps it to [0,1], and packs three CRTFtol conversions of the clamped value into an integer result.

local_names.v3: time sum fed to the triangular wave
local_names.c0: first CRTFtol conversion of the clamped value
local_names.c1: second CRTFtol conversion of the clamped value
local_names.c2: third CRTFtol conversion of the clamped value

operations.description: Sum the session-time global dbl_8AFEA0 and the float argument a3 into v3.
Side-effect call InterruptDispatch with the time sum.
Triangle wave: when v3 >= 0.5, v4 = 1.0 - ((v3 - 0.5) + (v3 - 0.5)); otherwise v4 = v3 + v3.
Clamp v4 into [0,1]: below 0 becomes 0.0, above 1 becomes 1.0.
Convert the clamped value to an integer three times via CRTFtol and assemble the conversions into a packed 32-bit integer.

unresolved: dbl_59E420, flt_59E43C, flt_59E440 and flt_59E450 are packet globals not referenced directly in the decompiled body; likely used inside callee subroutines (CRTFtol, InterruptDispatch). Their meaning is unresolved.
Exact byte layout of the packed result is decompiler-artifact dependent (the low conversion is duplicated) and unverified.
Purpose of the InterruptDispatch side-effect call is unknown.
